description: This file defines the RequestExceptionInterface, an interface for exceptions related to HTTP request failures within the PSR-7 HTTP Client standards. It extends the ClientExceptionInterface and includes a method to retrieve the request associated with the exception.

classes.name: RequestExceptionInterface
classes.description: Interface for exceptions that occur during HTTP request execution, providing a method to get the associated request object.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request associated with the exception. The returned object may differ from the original request passed to the client.
